writeup: TIC 165535747 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 1.2497 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing 3.50% dimming, with a signal-to-noise ratio of 150.6 in the transit-search algorithm. No secondary eclipse was detected. Pixel-level difference imaging confirmed the signal at the target location with a peak signal-to-noise of 18.4, though the centroid offset of 0.5 arcsec warrants attention in future observations. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel object for follow-up study. The automated machine-learning screening assigned it a score of 0.31, reflecting moderate confidence in its reality as a stellar system.
